strings.name: Kamala Harris
strings.role: Former US vice president · Former senator
strings.summary: Harris moved from California prosecution to national politics as San Francisco district attorney, California attorney general and US senator. Vice president from 2021 to 2025, she was the first woman, Black person and person of South Asian descent in the office. After Biden withdrew in 2024, she became the Democratic presidential nominee and lost to Trump. Her memoir 107 Days revisits that campaign.
